assign.outcome:
**Spacing is a clamp now, never a constant — and the broken imagine pages are fixed.** Root tokens `--pad-default: clamp(1em, 1.3%, 2em)` and `--gap-default: clamp(1em, 0.4em + 0.5vw, 1.6em)` feed every `.pad`/`.gap`/wall/cols fallback (calibrated so nothing moves below 1280); the columns host scales `--page-column-pad-x/y` by the row (`cqi` — crumb bar, heads, items and prose share one indent, 0.9em→3em); `small` scales `clamp(14em, 16cqi, 24em)`, the default ceiling `clamp(40em, 42cqi, 46em)`; column prose is capped at the measure (`.ac("wide")` opts a table out). The named fails are dead: "CLOSEST REAL MISS" sat at x:0 on a bled card wall — now x:49, because **bleed is for paint** (cards/text never bleed; padding, layout and system study pages de-bled); the design column was 252px at 3440 — now 828px (ten `width: "small"` pages converted to default; game/screens/word-demo labs keep theirs deliberately, and `small` itself now scales). Two pages the owner asked for: [One rule](/imagine/design/padding/one-rule/) — `padding: clamp(0.75em, 3.5cqi, 2.5em)` proven live at five slot widths plus the three em-based control variants — and [Approved](/imagine/design/layout/approved/) — the five-layout closed set and the gate that keeps a sixth out. The layout skill now carries all of it (spacing-and-bleed rules + three x-invariants in the measure cycle), so the next audit cannot miss what these kept missing.
